idea.title: Hidden basics: why buyers don't bother asking
idea.angle: No location, no bedroom count, no price: people who have to ask for basics often don't bother. Showing the basics filters out time-wasters and brings serious buyers forward.
idea.hook: IF THEY HAVE TO ASK, THEY LEAVE

slides.heading: IF THEY HAVE TO ASK, THEY **LEAVE**
slides.body: Hiding the basics doesn't create mystery. It creates silence.

slides.heading: SAVING THE DETAILS FOR THE **DMS**
slides.body: No price. No location. No bedroom count. You hope buyers will message to ask. Most don't bother.

slides.heading: SILENCE, THEN "**HOW MUCH?**"
slides.body: Serious buyers scroll past. The few who message just want the price. Your day goes on chats that go nowhere.

slides.heading: SHOW THE **BASICS** UP FRONT
slides.body: A buyer should know in seconds if the home fits. Then the people who message are already interested.

slides.heading: WHAT EVERY POST **NEEDS**
bullets: Location: the area, so they know if it works.
Type: for sale or for rent.

slides.heading: THE PRICE IS A **FILTER**
slides.body: I know showing it feels risky. But it filters out time-wasters. The people who message already know it fits.

slides.heading: SAME HOME. **NOTHING** HIDDEN.
slides.body:
Before: Lovely home for sale. DM for details and price.
After:
✓ 4 bedrooms · 3 bathrooms · for sale
✓ [Area, City]
✓ [Price]
✓ DM "TOUR" to book a viewing.

slides.heading: GET THE **5-LINE** CAPTION
slides.body: Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook

caption:
Buyers who have to ask for the basics usually just scroll on.

No price, no location, no bedroom count means silence.
Show the basics up front. The price filters out time-wasters.
The people who message you already know the home fits.
